More than 200 residents of Ogun State have benefited from free diabetes screening and medication provided by the Lions Club in Abeokuta, the state capital, in collaboration with Ikeja Dynamic Model Lions Club, as part of activities marking World Diabetes Day. The outreach was held on Saturday at the Skating Ground, Abeokuta, in collaboration with Lions International Club District 404B4 Nigeria to promote early detection of diabetes and encourage residents to embrace preventive healthcare. Speaking at the medical outreach, the President of Abeokuta Lions Club, Idowu Shomade, said the initiative was aimed at identifying residents who might be living with diabetes without knowing their health status. Shomade said, “Some people might have this illness within themselves and probably do not have an idea of it. Diabetes does not necessarily show on somebody’s face, and a person may not know he has it until he is diagnosed. “Early detection would give us the opportunity to address it at an early stage before it escalates into complications that may not be easily managed. Hence, this kind of outreach.” Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Also speaking, the President of Ikeja Dynamic Model Lions Club, Temitayo Oshunremi, said the club, in collaboration with its Abeokuta counterparts, organised the healthcare outreach to support residents of the state. Oshunremi explained that the exercise was part of the Lions’ commitment to community service, noting that diabetes was one of the focal areas of Lions Clubs International. We are looking at screening over 200 people, and we have also gone into the community to create awareness among residents of the Panseke area,” he said. Also speaking, Abioodun Sowunmi said the outreach was a way of giving back to the community and fulfilling the organisation’s annual service commitments. He said early detection and awareness would help residents understand how to manage their health and take appropriate steps to prevent complications. “My message to the people of Abeokuta is that we want Abeokuta to be free of diabetes.
